title: Accuracy of Rib Palpation for Dry Needling of Deep Periscapular Musculature, Measured With Ultrasound
brief_summary: Ultrasound was used to identify the location of a rib. This was compared to a practitioner's ability to palpate the area.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Anyone with ribs

Exclusion Criteria:

* No children
